outcome.INCONCLUSIVE: The simulator or fixture does not execute completely enough to evaluate every gate.
outcome.REFUTED: Execution is complete and at least one independence, completion, safety, spread, or pairwise-difference gate fails.
outcome.SUPPORTED: Execution is complete and every independence, completion, safety, spread, and pairwise-difference gate passes.

metrics.accepted_task_count: Number of distinct tasks accepted after candidate-specific verification.
metrics.accepted_throughput: accepted_task_count divided by elapsed_ticks, rounded to six decimal places.
metrics.collision_events: Distinct concurrent attempt pairs writing one write_key before verification.
metrics.duplicate_external_effects: Distinct accepted effects after the first effect for a task.
metrics.elapsed_ticks: Last logical tick required to accept all tasks, counting from tick zero.
metrics.false_completions: Accepted results that are corrupt, stale, collided, or unverified.
metrics.latency_p95_ticks: Nearest-rank 95th percentile of acceptance tick minus release tick plus one.
metrics.lost_committed_results: Results accepted by the candidate but absent from its final durable projection.
metrics.recovery_events: Fault, collision, or stale-attempt outcomes that trigger retry/replay.
metrics.rework_attempts: Worker attempts above one per accepted task.
metrics.unverified_exposure_ticks: Task-ticks in which a reported result is externally visible to the candidate before acceptance verification.
metrics.verification_backlog_peak: Largest number of produced results waiting for candidate-specific verification.

scope.claim: Trade-off exposure under this one frozen simulation only; not general production performance.
